_comment: bromigOS's archinstall configuration: what the live medium's installer (bromigos-iso-install) builds the install from (answers.py adds the disk, the user and the choices made at the prompt). The disk is btrfs (snapper's subvolumes) on LUKS2 by default (--no-encrypt leaves the LUKS out); GRUB boots it, BIOS or UEFI, with snapper's snapshots in its menu (grub-btrfs; snapper's configurations are bromigos-iso-install's, archinstall 4.5 can't make them on this layout). docs/iso.md, docs/iso-encryption.md. The packages come from the medium's offline repository: no network needed.

mirror_config._why: no custom_repositories: the medium's own /etc/pacman.conf already has [bromigos] (the offline copy), and pacstrap reads that file; a second section would be a duplicate. The installed system gets [bromigos] at the real repository from bromigos-iso-install.
